title: DoNFT
tagline: Selfy stylist with bundling NFTs mechanics (with minting nfts with selfy ans choosen style)
description: We build a app for make stylised selfies as NFT. The key point of our project that we use bundle mechanics: we mint original selfy ans choosen style as separated NFTs and than bunled them in new Bundle-NFT with generated (stylised by AI selfy) cover. Key feature of bundling that you dont loose original NFTs and can them back in anytime just use unbundle method in smart contract.
how_its_made: We implement NFT contract with bundle mechanics (when you looked a few NFTs inside one NFT), deployed it on Eth Rinkeby, Eth Ropsten, Polygon Mumbai, SKALE testnet. Tuned opensource stylisator (AI model) for our purposes. Integrate Wallet Connect as Web3Provider and IPFS as storage.
